subject: Evaluation Stewardship — ownership decision grid & next sprint
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyam@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed stewardship grid for evaluation

Hi Asha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the proposed next steps so we have alignment before we draft the formal mutual action plan: 

1) Primary success criteria you outlined: average latency below 350ms for 512-token generative flows, embedding recall >= 92% on the 10k query set, and no PII leakage from test prompts.
2) Trial scope: 2-week focused trial of the inference path (hosted Dedicated sim) + a short integration with your sandbox app to validate end-to-end.
3) Ownership questions we flagged on the call: who owns the sandbox infra (GFH cloud ops?), who will approve security tests, and procurement contact for PO/contract.

I put together a lightweight stewardship decision grid (attached) that maps the four lanes we discussed — App, Infra, Security, Procurement — to owners, SLOs, escalation path, and an observability checklist. Can you confirm the GFH leads for each lane so we can lock RACI?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- GFH: confirm owners and procurement timeline by EOD Wed (11/11).
- Redwood: convert stewardship grid into a short mutual action plan and share DocuSign-ready T&C by Fri (11/13).
- Technical kickoff: schedule 30–45m session once owners are identified (aiming for week of 11/16).

Attachments: stewardship_grid.xlsx (owner matrix), mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (draft scope/acceptance criteria).

Thanks — I’ll stand by for owner names and any missing items.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Asha Rao <asha@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: platform@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed stewardship grid for evaluation

Ben — thanks for the summary and the attachment. Confirming owners: 

- App lead: Priya Sen (priya.sen@greenfieldhealth.com) — will own integration and acceptance testing.
- Infra lead: Luis Ortega (platform@greenfieldhealth.com) — sandbox infra and connectivity.
- Security reviewer: Asha Rao (me) and we’ll loop our security SME (cc’d on follow up).
- Procurement: Contracts queue — procurement@greenfieldhealth.com (PO lead: Elena Park).

We like the success criteria you listed. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a sample traffic generator to mimic 4 concurrent UX sessions?
- For the PII checks, can you run the redaction regression on our provided prompt set (we’ll share via Drive link)?

We’ll confirm exact people in the next 24 hours and aim to get procurement timeline to you by Thursday. Please include any test harness docs in the MAP.

— Asha
Head of Platform, Greenfield Health
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyam@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: stewardship grid — internal alignment + immediate asks

Team — forwarding GFH confirmation (below). Action items for Redwood pre-kickoff: 

1) Technical test harness: Marcus, can you scope a lightweight traffic generator (4 concurrent UX sessions, 512-token flows, configurable QPS) and a runbook for how GFH will execute it in their sandbox? Target: prototype harness by 11/15.
2) Security checks: Soojin, can you prepare the redaction/regression checklist and a short script to run their prompt set (once GFH shares it)? Also include expected outputs so GFH can validate locally.
3) Procurement support: Kimberly, please draft a one-pager that summarizes acceptance criteria and payment milestones so procurement has what they need. We should include the proposed SLA and refund/credit language for missed SLOs.

I’m attaching the stewardship_grid.xlsx with my initial owner suggestions filled from the call; we’ll update with GFH names once they confirm.

Can everyone reply with ETA on their action by EOD tomorrow so I can roll into the MAP. If you want to reassign, flag now.

— Ben
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, priyam@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800

Ben — quick status update and consolidated stewardship decision grid (attached).

Status: 
- Marcus: prototype traffic generator ready by 2026-11-15 (uses simple curl-based runner + token payloads).
- Soojin: redaction/regression checklist + example script ready by 2026-11-15; will need GFH prompt set (please upload link).
- Kimberly (procurement one-pager): draft attached. I included milestone-based billing (30% on kickoff, 50% on acceptance, 20% on extension) and proposed SLA credits (5% credit per missed weekly SLO up to 20%).

Decision grid highlights (consolidated): 
- App: Owner required from GFH (Priya Sen) — Redwood assists with integration stubs and acceptance tests.
- Infra: GFH owns sandbox; Redwood provides network connectivity checklist and a temporary dedicated capacity token for the trial.
- Security: Joint review — GFH approves final redaction test; Redwood runs regression and shares logs (redacted).
- Procurement: GFH procurement to own PO and timing; Redwood provides templated T&C and one-pager.

Next steps: I’ll convert the grid into the MAP PDF and share the DocuSign draft by EOD 11/13; Ben — please confirm whether GFH procurement wants a formal SOW or the one-pager + MAP will suffice to issue the PO.

— Kimberly
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
